meta.title: The buyer cannot open an ordinary bid on their own event
gaps: library case BID-SURR-002 is written for a vendor's session, but the plan sends it as the buyer

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
